requirements.text: Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computational Sciences, or a related technical discipline.
At least 3 years of relevant software engineering experience in industry, academia, or a research environment.
Must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
Remote – US (Must be available during Pacific Time business hours)
Strong hands-on experience developing modern web applications using React, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
Solid understanding of frontend architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles.
Experience integrating frontend applications with backend APIs and relational databases.
Experience developing interactive dashboards, data-driven interfaces, or visualizations for technical users.
Experience developing software applications for scientific research, engineering, computational biology, chemistry, or other data-intensive technical domains.
Familiarity with data visualization libraries and frameworks such as D3.js, Plotly, or similar technologies.
Full-stack development experience, including exposure to Python or other backend programming languages.
Experience building interfaces for computational workflows, job monitoring, data analysis, or research platforms.
Familiarity with cloud-based applications, distributed computing environments, or machine learning platforms.
Experience collaborating directly with scientists, researchers, or other specialized technical users to develop software solutions.
